''Egg Hunt''
6 April 2020 – 29 April 2020 |part_of = Roblox's [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]] |previous_event = [[Christmas 2019 Event|Christmas 2019]] |next_event = [[Halloween 2020 Event|Halloween 2020]] }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Spring 2020 Event''', also known as the '''Easter 2020 Event''', was the fifth event to be added to Tower Defense Simulator. It was also the first event to be added in 2020. This event gave a new tower, the [[Swarmer]], for beating [[Eggy Island]] hard mode, as well as a return of {{Tickets|}} to purchase [[Bunny Crate]]s. This event was added against the backdrop of the [[w:c:roblox:Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.|Egg Hunt 2020: Agents of E.G.G.]]. You could get the Tower of Eggs accessory by triumphing [[Eggy Island]] easy mode between the 6th of April 2020 and 29th of April 2020. You could still beat [[Eggy Island]] easy mode after this date, but you would not get the accessory. You could also get the {{RLinkC|4771626425|Star Creaeggtor Egg}}, {{RLinkC|4771627322|Eggveloper Egg of "X,Y,Z"}} and the {{RLinkC|4771625250|Eleggtrifying Eggmin of 2020}} egg if you grabbed an egg from their respective launcher between these dates. For a limited time only, players could equip a gear in the lobby (namely the [[Eggphone]]). Players with any of the egg launchers could also equip it in the lobby. ==Maps== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:EggyIslandMap.png|200px|link=Eggy Island]] |- |[[Eggy Island]] |} ==Towers== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Swarmer.png|200px|link=Swarmer]] |- |[[Swarmer]] |} ==Crates== {| class="empty-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:300px; margin:0 auto" |[[File:Bunny Crate.png|200px|link=Bunny Crate]] |- |[[Bunny Crate]] |} ==Accessories== These are accessories that you can wear on your Roblox avatar. These do not necessarily equate to any value in the game or benefit you in any way whatsoever while playing Tower Defense Simulator (or any other game). You could only obtain these eggs between the 6th of April 2020 and 29th of April 2020. {| class="light-table pad-5 align-center" style="width:600px; margin:0 auto" ! |[[File:TowerOfEggs.png|200px]] |[[File:StarEgg.png|200px]] |[[File:DeveloperEgg.png|200px]] |[[File:AdminEgg.png|200px]] |- ! |{{RLinkC|4786878003|Tower of Eggs}} |{{RLinkC|4771626425|Star Creaeggtor Egg}} |{{RLinkC|4771627322|Eggveloper Egg of "X,Y,Z"}} |{{RLinkC|4771625250|Eleggtrifying Eggmin of 2020}} |- !Obtainment Method |Triumph [[Eggy Island]] on easy mode |Grab it when shot from the [[Star Creaeggtor Cannon 9001]] |Grab it when shot from the [[Eggveloper Cannon 9002]] |Grab it when shot from the [[Eggmin Cannon 9000]] |} ==Gears== These are all the gears that you could equip in the Tower Defense Simulator lobby. You could only equip these gears if you have the gear in your Roblox inventory. Other gears could not be equipped.
